explanation: The difference in amount between year 2 and year 3 is the interest earned on year 2 amount. Interest = 6000 - 5000 = 1000 INR. Rate = (1000) / 5000 * 100 = 20%.
Removing a portion of the mixture does not change the ratio/concentration of milk. The other three operations add more water relative to milk, decreasing the milk concentration.
Daily rates: A = 1/10, B = 1/15. Combined daily rate = 1/10 + 1/15 = 5/30 = 1/6. In 3 days, work completed = 3 * (1/6) = 1/2 = 50%. Remaining work = 100% - 50% = 50%.
